Something was afoot. A blind spot in the gaze of the Lidless Eye, something outside his vision. If there was even Nothing, he would know, yet… here was Something seen as Nothing. Whatever it was - insofar as it could *be* a what - it reeked of malice to the Mad God. Contempt. Anger. Fear, the fear when a predator notices a rival move into his hunting lands. Fear when the apex is threatened… Something must be done. He tried to warn the others, but they dismissed it as the ravings of a madman. And so, something was formed. A contigency plan.

One thousand years it took. A starship to end all starships, an escape vessel for when a god's existence is threatened - the Starjammer. A small vessel, one would smirk at its jet-black exterior that seemed to devour all light that touched it, citing numerous clichéd fashion laws - "Black is sooooo two centuries ago" - and they would miss the point entirely. The Starjammer was a vessel built for one thing and one thing only - transit from A to B faster than anything else, all while remaining completely invisible. Weaved from the very primordial forces of the universe, its internal space was limitless. One may say, one may shrug with a smirk plastered across the front of their head - "Why would a **god** need a vehicle? Can't they just teleport?" - and they again would be dead wrong. The Starjammer was made to stitch together realities, go deeper into multiverses of multiverses than any had ever gone and where even gods dare not tread - all for escape, the proverbial lynchpin of the Grand Design.
